inlineImageAndParagraph.text:
NMC Verification is the process of confirming whether a medical professional — typically a doctor or physician — is registered with the National Medical Commission (NMC) of India, the statutory body that regulates and maintains standards of medical education and practice under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019. Every qualified medical practitioner in India must hold a valid NMC registration number to practice medicine legally.

Decentro's NMC Verification API enables businesses and healthcare platforms to instantly validate a doctor's credentials by querying their NMC registration number against the official NMC registry — returning the practitioner's name, registration number, qualification, and registration status in real time, without any document uploads or manual verification.

inlineImageAndParagraph2.headingLight: What Makes Decentro's NMC Verification API
inlineImageAndParagraph2.text: Decentro's NMC Verification API connects directly to the official National Medical Commission registry to return verified practitioner credentials in under 2 seconds — no document uploads, no OCR, no manual review. Unlike basic verification tools that rely on scraped databases or cached records, our API queries the source registry in real time, returning the doctor's full name, registration number, qualification, date of registration, and current status in a single structured response.Built within Decentro's unified professional verification framework, it integrates seamlessly alongside other KYC and professional verification APIs for end-to-end healthcare and workforce onboarding workflows.

subBanner.text: Decentro's NMC Verification API enables real-time validation of medical practitioners against the National Medical Commission registry, delivering verified results in under 500ms with comprehensive details including Registration Number, Qualification, and State Medical Council affiliation.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: NMC Verification is the process of validating a medical practitioner's credentials against the National Medical Commission (formerly MCI) database. It confirms the authenticity of a doctor's registration number, qualifications, and license status, ensuring that only legitimate and authorized medical professionals are onboarded onto healthcare platforms, insurance networks, and telemedicine services.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Why is NMC Verification important for businesses?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: NMC Verification is critical for healthcare platforms, insurance companies, hospital chains, and telemedicine providers to ensure regulatory compliance and patient safety. It helps prevent fraudulent practitioners from entering the ecosystem, reduces liability risks, and builds trust with end consumers by guaranteeing that listed doctors hold valid and recognized medical credentials.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Who can use Decentro's NMC Verification API?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Healthtech platforms, telemedicine providers, insurance companies, hospital management systems, pharmacy networks, corporate wellness platforms, and any business that needs to verify the credentials of medical professionals can leverage Decentro's NMC Verification API for seamless and automated doctor verification at scale.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How is Decentro's NMC Verification API different from manual verification?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Unlike manual verification, which involves time-consuming searches on government portals and is prone to human error, Decentro's NMC Verification API automates the entire process via a single API call. It delivers real-time, accurate results in milliseconds, supports bulk verification, and integrates seamlessly into existing onboarding and compliance workflows.
